_doc: AQG Ledger capture hooks (v2 SessionStart anchor + Stop commit-capture; v2.1 PostToolUse(Bash) PR-creation capture). OPT-IN and OFF BY DEFAULT: copy these three hook arrays into ~/.claude/settings.json under the existing 'hooks' key. Captures git commits + PR creations (observed network-free from `gh pr create` output) made in the project repo during the session as LOW-FIDELITY 'aqg-hook' progress events in the per-machine-local ledger (<AQG_DATA>/ledger/_inbox/); it NEVER writes the network/cloud and NEVER drives the defect state machine (progress-only). The PostToolUse hook fires on every Bash command but cheaply grep-pre-filters before doing any work. Inline AQG_ROOT/python3 checks keep Claude Code working if AQG is uninstalled. CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR is forwarded so the writer pins to the actual project dir instead of the hook's runtime cwd. View captured work with the aqg-project-status skill. POSIX (macOS/Linux) only; Windows users adapt to a PowerShell equivalent.

hooks.command: if [ -z "${AQG_ROOT:-}" ]; then exit 0; fi; if ! command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; bash "$AQG_ROOT/agent-packs/claude-code/hooks/sessionstart_ledger_anchor.sh" "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}" || true

if [ -z "${AQG_ROOT:-}" ]; then exit 0; fi; if ! command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; bash "$AQG_ROOT/agent-packs/claude-code/hooks/stop_ledger_capture.sh" "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}" || true

if [ -z "${AQG_ROOT:-}" ]; then exit 0; fi; if ! command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; bash "$AQG_ROOT/agent-packs/claude-code/hooks/posttooluse_pr_capture.sh" "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}" || true
